verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is itself a built-in AI assistant. First-party sources describe AI agents that work out of the box, custom agent skills, Agent Flows for custom workflows, web scraping and search, and automatic meeting transcription and summarization with action items. Together these show users can hand tasks to the in-product agent. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what agents can autonomously do (most agent items are page titles only), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent task delegation (community comments cover chat/RAG, not agents).
